claims.text: Les Misérables was first staged in Paris in 1980.
The original production of Les Misérables did not open in London, New York or Montreal.
Les Misérables was written in French by Claude-Michel Schönberg and Alain Boublil.
The original production was staged at the Palais des Sports, a sports arena in Paris.
The English-language production opened in London in 1985, five years after the Paris original.
